description: Runtime correctness scan for the Luke codebase. Finds race conditions, async bugs, N+1 queries, memory leaks, null crashes, error propagation failures, stale closures, React logic bugs and check-then-act races across a permission boundary. Escalates security-impacting defects to /luke-security rather than running its own exploit hunt. Use when asked to find bugs, do a bug assessment, or check for runtime issues.
